_what: ONE coverage record against four reference libraries, with THREE SEPARATE NUMBERS per library and no single score.
_why: Every previous coverage answer in this programme was a fraction, and a fraction hides which of three different things went wrong. Borrowed from ds-contracts-poc’s own census, whose headline was 100% clean over 1,618 sets and whose caveat is the point: "Refusal-free is not pixel-right." It scored perfectly while naming 3,316 capture degradations, because CLEAN and COMPLETE are different questions and one number cannot answer both.

_the_three_numbers.denominator: How many units the reference library HAS. Hand-authored from a measurement of the library itself, never derived from what site-factory happens to cover - an instrument that computes its own denominator cannot be surprised.
_the_three_numbers.answered: How many of those units site-factory has a counterpart for. A pairing, not a judgement of quality.
_the_three_numbers.facts_carried: Of the units answered, how much of the CONTRACT actually survived into a record: axes, property kinds, states. This is the number that says whether "answered" means anything.

_honesty_rule: A denominator nobody measured is recorded as UNMEASURED and NOT as a large round number. Two of the four are unmeasured, and writing "400+" for one of them would turn an advertisement into a statistic.

uber-base.what: Uber Base, the product design system. Harvested from the Gallery file.

denominator.source: vendor/uber-base-contracts.json, harvested through the Gallery duplicate 2026-07-31. SUPERSEDES the 92/3,211 in vendor/uber-base-tiers.json, which counted what a top-level page walk could see rather than what is referenced.

answered.how: a site-factory block pairs to a Base component set by name; see vendor/base-axis-reconciliation.json

facts_carried.axes: MEASURED at last, and the answer is poor. Of 14 paired blocks, ONE matches Base in both axis name and values (progresssteps). Three carry Base’s exact value set under a different name. Six reuse a Base axis NAME for different values. Four ask a question no Base axis asks.
facts_carried.multi_axis_collapse: Every one of the 14 collapses a multi-axis Base set into a single axis. Base carries 2 to 7 axes per set; site-factory carries 1. pagination is 7 axes and 423 variants there against 1 axis and 2 variants here.
facts_carried.note: The earlier entry read "NOT MEASURED per set" with a known_loss that Base axes "were never harvested at all". They are now, and the loss was larger than the placeholder implied.

degradations: The axis VOCABULARY was invented rather than inherited, while REFERENCES.md records Base as the baseline. What actually came from Base is the palette, the type ramp and 16 redrawn sets - not the variant grammar.

radio is the sharpest: Base carries State[Enabled,Disabled] AND Selected Unselected[Selected,Unselected]; mine carries one axis named State holding Base’s SECOND axis’s values, so a reader who knows Base misreads it.
IMPORT is still blocked - the library is not subscribed and its keys do not resolve. Reading a contract needed no subscription; placing an instance still does.

relume.what: Relume Figma Kit v3.7, the marketing section library.

denominator.source: vendor/relume-coverage.json, a measured read of the duplicated kit

facts_carried.note: NOT MEASURED. Coverage here is CATEGORY-level: it says a category is answered, never that any particular set’s contract was carried.
facts_carried.known_loss: No Relume set contributes an axis, a property or a state to any register record. The kit informed which SECTIONS to build and nothing about their contracts.

degradations: 14 categories unanswered, named in vendor/relume-coverage.json rather than counted only

simple-design-system.what: Figma’s own Simple Design System. The extraction test subject, because both twins are published and neither is mine.

denominator.source: UNMEASURED. The kit advertises "400+ components" and an advertisement is not a measurement. Only a search for "button" has been run against it.

answered.how: imported by key and the full Figma-side contract recorded

facts_carried.axes: YES, all 7 sets, with every value
facts_carried.note: This is the only library where facts_carried is a real number rather than a note, because it is the only one where the contract was actually read.

degradations: INSTANCE_SWAP and SLOT have NO counterpart in PropContract, so 6 instance swaps and 1 slot were read and cannot be recorded.
PropContract.figmaProperty is a bare NAME with no KIND, so a recorded binding cannot say whether it is a variant axis, a text prop or an icon swap.
The CODE half has not been compared yet, which is the entire reason this subject was chosen.

material-3.what: Google’s Material 3 Design Kit, subscribed as a library.

denominator.source: UNMEASURED. One search returned 20 button and toggle sets; nothing has enumerated the kit.

degradations: Its set DESCRIPTIONS carry the semantic contract in prose ("Five color options: elevated, filled, tonal, outlined, and text"), which is a contract source nothing here reads.

_own_library.note: site-factory’s OWN surface, recorded here for scale rather than as coverage of anything.

_what_this_cannot_say: Whether any answered unit is any GOOD. Every number here is a pairing or a count.
Whether the two unmeasured denominators are large or small. They are unknown, and unknown is not zero and not four hundred.
Anything about a library not listed. Four were chosen; the absence of a fifth is not evidence about it.
